drhp.business: Bharat Gears Limited (BGL) manufactures high-quality precision-engineered gears, sub-assemblies/aggregates, heat-treatment furnaces, and automotive components. It caters to diverse industries including agriculture, construction equipment, commercial vehicles, and EVs, with a global presence across 14 countries. The company is the first independent Indian gear manufacturer to develop bevel gear grinding capabilities and operates the largest dry cutting facility in India.

risks.note: The Company relies on short-term borrowings and undrawn facilities; â¹6,949.97 lakhs of variable-rate debt matures within one year, requiring continuous access to banking lines and cash flow to avoid liquidity stress.
